# Contributing

**atelier is not accepting external code contributions until v2.0.0.**

This is deliberate. Every line of atelier so far was written by AI and has **not**
been reviewed by the maintainer line by line. v2.0.0 is the milestone where I
(Marmik) start reviewing the code in detail and contributing to it directly — it
will be tagged by hand, and it is the one release an AI agent is not allowed to
cut. Until then, external pull requests are **closed automatically** with a link
back to this file.

## What genuinely helps right now

- **Bug reports** — open an issue with steps to reproduce. Very useful.
- **Ideas and feedback** — open an issue.
- **Using it** and telling me what broke or what you wished it did.

Please don't open pull requests before v2.0.0 — they'll be closed, not ignored,
but closed. Thanks for understanding; this keeps the review milestone meaningful.

## After v2.0.0

Once the review milestone lands, this policy opens up and this file will describe
the real contribution flow (branch, draft PR, green `make pre-commit-checks &&
make test`, squash-merge). Until then: issues, not PRs.
